liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Reviewer calls Stella Blue beautiful, part of a mellow run with He's Gone and The Wheel before Miracle [15]
- **Loser** (1 review): Loser is called outstanding by this reviewer [16]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): Iko Iko opener is loose and funky, setting the tone for the show [18]
- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Shakedown Street on this soundboard as the Owsley mix [21]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd80-10-07 s1t01 Iko Iko**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd80-10-07 s1t02 Dark Hollow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd80-10-07 s1t03 Rosalie McFall**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd80-10-07 s1t04 Monkey & The Engineer**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd80-10-07 s1t05 To Lay Me Down**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd80-10-07 s1t06 Heaven Help The Fool**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd80-10-07 s1t07 Deep Elem Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd80-10-07 s1t08 El Paso**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-10-07.144739.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 31 songs; 205 min [1]
- **gd1980-10-07.151440.sbd.1st-gen.miller.fix.t.flac16**: soundboard; 29 songs; 218 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1980-10-07.151264.sbd.healy.miller.fixed.flac2496**: soundboard; 29 songs; 218 min [4]
- **gd1980-10-07.170840.sbd.cassette-master.miller.fix1.flac2496**: soundboard; 29 songs; 219 min [5]
- **gd80-10-07.menke.vernon.14046.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 27 songs; 187 min; rated 3.7/5 by 10 [10]. Said about its sound: Audience recording reviewed as very good, though Cold Rain & Snow has a fade-out; Audience tape captures friends' voices between songs [14][22]
- **gd80-10-07.partial.sbd.cousinit.24664.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 15 songs; 85 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [12]. Said about its sound: Soundboard is only partial, but the sound is nice [18]

## Around the show

- The Warfield is an intimate room with excellent acoustics, which helps an audience taper capture quality sound [14]
- Reviewer attended 12 of the 15 Warfield shows in this run; this was their 50th Dead show [22]
- The mellow third-set stretch before the rocking Miracle is called unusual; reviewer also loves the Sept/Oct 1980 acoustic sets [15]
- This Loser is ranked alongside the one from 5/8/77 [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-10-07.144739.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII) [1]. Also: Master cassettes came from Mark Severson; Charlie Miller transferred them and coordinated the release, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones; A first-generation Nakamichi 700 source supplies the first 25 seconds of Iko Iko and a short patch in El Paso > Ripple; The same Nakamichi source supplies Me & My Uncle > Big River, Althea, and Little Red Rooster complete, plus a Drums patch [1]
- **gd1980-10-07.151440.sbd.1st-gen.miller.fix.t.flac16**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 27, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550) > Cassette (Sony TC-D5M/TDK SA-C90) [3]. Also: First-generation soundboard transfer with the Cold Rain And Snow dropout repaired; otherwise untouched; A second soundboard source covers tape flips and some tunings; converted from 24-bit to 16-bit at 44.1 [3]
- **gd1980-10-07.151264.sbd.healy.miller.fixed.flac2496**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 27, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550) > Cassette (Sony TC-D5M/TDK SA-C90) [4]. Also: Soundboard transfer with the Cold Rain And Snow dropout fixed and nothing else altered; A second soundboard source fills the tape flips and some tunings [4]
- **gd1980-10-07.170840.sbd.cassette-master.miller.fix1.flac2496**: transferred by All Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 10, 2025; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Maxell UDXL-II) > WAV (24-bit/96k) [5]. Also: Cassette master soundboard; the tape flip in Little Red Rooster was patched using material from Mark Severson and Scott Clugston [5]
- **gd80-10-07.menke.vernon.14046.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Bob Menke; source: Audience Recording: Nak CM700's [10]
- **gd80-10-07.partial.sbd.cousinit.24664.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Cousinit; source: Soundboard [12]
